entities.name: NSAG information
entities.description: Information element that provides NSAG (Network Slice Assistance Information Group) information to the UE when included by the network.

entities.name: 5GMM capability
entities.description: Information element that indicates the UE's 5GMM capabilities, including support for NSAG.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by the UE to initiate registration procedure with the network.

entities.name: NSAG supported condition
entities.description: Condition where the UE has set the NSAG bit to 'NSAG supported' in the 5GMM capability IE.

entities.name: NSAG bit set to supported
entities.description: Property indicating the UE has configured the NSAG capability bit to indicate support.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains the 5GMM capability information element.
The 5GMM capability IE guards the NSAG supported condition through the NSAG bit setting.
When the NSAG supported condition is met, the network may include the NSAG information IE.
